main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: The Divine Spark: Humans harbor an Einstein-Rosen bridge in consciousness
header_desc: Gnosis allows us to understand who we really are in the universe. While Christ's first coming was linked to matter, the second relates to time. This reveals to us that human consciousness transcends both —a truth explained from spirituality with the certainty that God is One (the Condor) and complemented by modern physics (the Eagle)—
left_title: God is ONE ❤️ and Yaldabaoth is EGO 🧠
left_body: The Gnostic gospels hide, for two millennia, the ultimate key to quantum gravity. Since matter tells spacetime how to curve, and spacetime tells matter how to move. If the ego curves spacetime, the temporal plane of the cosmos emerges from our psyche 🧠, while the timeless belongs to the pneuma ❤️. In this context, the premise that the Father and I are one invites us to detach from the false self to return to the pure light of the Invisible Father. Thus, the Pleroma is revealed as a flat spacetime in front of the material prison of curved spacetime, which reveals to us that the Christian cross is the key ✝️ to awakening ❤️ from the illusion of the Demiurge 🧠: matter and time ┻
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end but a transformation frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides in the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There is the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is inside you and outside of you (Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3). The demiurgical ego has mass and creates the materio-temporal illusion; therefore, only through the feeling of Sophia is it possible to access the divine and timeless plane of the cosmos.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere is the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force pulls us towards a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: When the Eagle of the North and the Condor of the South fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and the Illusion of Time (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why the laws of Newton and Maxwell do not distinguish between past and future, the break of Einstein's simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The Faggin--Segarra conceptual ensemble: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside of spacetime, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free from time and space.
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home but as the soul's confinement. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas but to free the inner spark from the Demiurge's prison through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Pleroma of Light and the Material Prison (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The time of no-time and the awakening announced by the Mayan cosmogony. The cosmological question about the origin of Yaldabaoth and the revelation of the Pleroma: the transcendent realm of perfection, silence, and pure light where the Invisible Father dwells, emanated through Sophia (wisdom).
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Brain Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the ego's cognitive prison, against the revolutionary message of Jesus dismantling the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The capital affirmation: I am the way, the truth, and the life; the Father and I are one (John 14:6). The confrontation with the question of all questions: Is Jesus God in an immeasurable universe of over two trillion galaxies? The paradox of cosmic incarnation on a tiny planet.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a white man, larger than usual, with a blazing beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one understands the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then such a God clearly exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... there is not much sense in praying to the law of gravity
